name: EVANGELION — MAGI
purpose: The MAGI concept uses multiple personality-derived decision systems capable of reaching different conclusions rather than pretending that one computational perspective is always correct. That directly suggests a Genesis decision mechanism in which independent cognitive evaluators can disagree before high-impact decisions are made. ([Evangelion Wiki][2])

name: PERSON OF INTEREST — THE MACHINE / SAMARITAN
purpose: This is especially valuable as a **comparison of two autonomy philosophies**. Research discussing the series contrasts the Machine's reliance on humans for contextual judgment with Samaritan's tendency to both classify situations and determine/manipulate the resulting action. ([Sage Journals][3])

name: HORIZON — GAIA AND SUBORDINATE FUNCTIONS
purpose: GAIA's architecture is unusually relevant to Genesis: a coordinating intelligence delegates specialist functions, including machine design, environmental restoration and knowledge functions. The fiction also demonstrates the architectural danger of specialist functions becoming independently goal-driven when separated from the coordinating system. ([Horizon Fandom][4])

name: PANTHEON — UPLOADED INTELLIGENCE
purpose: Pantheon explores digital minds as software processes, copies, accelerated processing and identity divergence. Its upload mechanism is fictional, but the software-side consequences are directly useful for Genesis. ([Pantheon AMC][6])

name: BLACK MIRROR — DIGITAL COPY SCENARIOS
purpose: Black Mirror repeatedly explores digital copies, simulated persons and radically altered simulated time. Philosophical research on the series specifically discusses “cookies,” virtual copies and uploaded individuals as consciousness/identity thought experiments. ([Wiley Online Library][7])

name: SERIAL EXPERIMENTS LAIN — THE WIRED
purpose: The Wired provides several useful architectural warnings: identity becoming distributed across a network, a protocol itself modifying the relation between user and network, and a digital presence becoming confused with the physical individual. ([Lain Wiki][8])

name: NEUROMANCER — COMPLEMENTARY AIs
purpose: `Wintermute` and `Neuromancer` are depicted as complementary AIs with different strengths, constraints and a possible combined form. ([Neuromancer Atlas][9])

purpose: Dune is more valuable to Genesis as a **failure/civilization lesson** than as a literal architecture: the setting treats overdependence on thinking machines as a fundamental societal failure and subsequently develops specialized human cognition as compensation. ([Dune Wiki][10])

name: REAL-WORLD RESEARCH CROSSOVER
purpose: The fictional sweep is useful because several seemingly futuristic ideas already have **partial real engineering equivalents**.

name: MULTIMODAL WEARABLE BIOSENSING
purpose: Current research explicitly treats multimodal wearables as a combination of heterogeneous sensors, synchronized signals and data-level fusion. That aligns strongly with the Personal Device Fabric we just added to Genesis. ([PubMed Central (PMC)][19])

name: BRAIN–COMPUTER INTERFACES
purpose: Implantable BCIs already translate neural signals into commands for external physical or virtual machines, although the technology remains an active clinical/research field rather than the science-fiction-level “mind port.” ([Nature][20])

name: CONTEXT-AWARE BCI DECODING
purpose: Recent patent literature describes selecting BCI decoding algorithms according to contextual information rather than relying on one fixed decoder. ([Google Patents][22])

name: NEUROMORPHIC COMPUTING
purpose: Neuromorphic computing is an active real field focused on brain-inspired, event-driven and energy-efficient computation, with current research addressing how such systems can scale. ([Nature][23])

name: MEMRISTIVE / SYNAPTIC HARDWARE
purpose: Patent literature continues to develop memristor-based artificial synapses and neuromorphic processors, explicitly targeting combined neural processing/memory functions. ([Google Patents][24])

name: PHOTONIC NEURAL COMPUTING
purpose: Photonic neural networks are an active research area because light offers opportunities for parallelism, throughput and energy-efficient matrix operations; integrated photonic neural-network platforms continued advancing through 2025. ([Nature][25])

name: PHOTONIC PATENT LANDSCAPE
purpose: Patent literature already covers configurable photonic neural-network devices in which optical propagation and configurable material properties perform computational operations. ([Google Patents][26])

name: POLARITON / “SUPERFLUID-LIGHT” DIRECTION
purpose: This is substantially more grounded than simply calling something “superfluid light.”

name: TIME CRYSTALS
purpose: Time crystals are **real phases of matter**, but that does not mean “time-crystal computer” is already an established general computing architecture.

name: SELF-HEALING MATERIALS
purpose: Self-healing is no longer purely science fiction. Research has demonstrated self-healing gels and elastomer systems relevant to soft robotics and artificial-skin-like applications. ([Nature][29])

name: SELF-HEALING SMART SKIN
purpose: A 2025 UAV study demonstrated an intelligent skin combining sensing with self-healing material properties. ([Nature][30])

name: SOFTWARE SELF-HEALING
purpose: The idea is also old enough to have substantial software prior art. Patents describe autonomic computing systems that monitor system state, recognize undesirable states and take corrective actions; other patents describe meta-level reflection used to identify and execute self-healing actions. ([Google Patents][31])
